RELEASE BRANCH COMPARISON · 2026.11.02

vLLM Ascend 分支演进与性能分析

upstream/releases/v0.31.0rc 相比 upstream/releases/v0.30.0rc2：合入历史、实际代码净差异，以及可定位到提交的性能优化点。

仓库：vllm-project/vllm-ascend全仓库范围Git + PR 作者说明离线报告 / 可筛选 / 可导出

01 · 核心结论

364新侧独有提交 / PR
55旧侧独有提交 / PR
44补丁等价项
6同源适配项
1140净变更文件
66性能及关联审阅记录
364 是提交历史差集，不是 364 项全新能力。其中 44 条与基线补丁等价，另 6 条是已回移的同源适配。剩下 314 条仅表示“未被本轮等价映射命中”，还包含文档、CI、重构、修复、回退与功能使能，不能直接叫作 314 项功能或优化。

新增性能工作主要落在 DSpark/Attention 小算子融合、PCP/OTP 与 SP 通信、GLM/GDN 拷贝和清零、KV Pool 主机开销、MRV2 图执行及多模态预处理。不同模型、硬件和开关命中不同路径，无法给出一个可信的“v0.31.0rc 整体提升百分比”。

提交标题中有 23 条显式 [Performance]，其中 3 条已在基线有完全等价回移，其余 20 条保留为新增优化提交候选。扩展审阅不局限于标签：本报告共记录 66 条性能及关联项，分类如下。

直接优化 / 性能恢复 34 条；性能相关能力 / 路径使能 18 条；基线已有 / 同源回移 4 条；关联适配 / 约束 5 条；后续替代的历史实现 1 条；撤销 / 收缩的优化路径 4 条。

分类是本报告的代码机制判断；各行“作者实测”来自特定 PR 场景。本次没有运行 NPU benchmark，未测两分支的端到端性能。优化机制的确定性、路径使能和测得收益分别陈述。

03 · 新侧代码主要演进

执行引擎与上游对齐

对齐 vLLM v0.31.0，扩大默认 MRV2 范围；V1、310P、xlite runner 目录隔离。这类迁移产生大量文件行差异，不能将行数解释为性能价值。

#18229 · #17681 · #18995 · #19159 · #18863 · #19330

Attention 与算子

新增/更换 FlashAttn、FlashMLA、mixed-quant SFA、CANN pooled indexing，融合 DSpark index 构建、MiniMax 准备/TopK 和 hc_pre 路径。硬件及 cache layout 条件较强。

#18717 · #18742 · #17354 · #16730 · #18295 · #16542 · #18294 · #18293

并行、MoE 与内存

PCP O projection 从权重交换转向 activation 交换并共享 scratch；恢复 SP MMRS 编译融合；优化 router dtype、事件和共享专家量化；修复共享 KV 池预算。

#18506 · #19190 · #18074 · #17068 · #17603 · #18474 · #19264 · #19521

KV Pool 与传输

减少 block/mask 扫描、lookup/save 开销，调整 KVPP layerwise 预取；扩展 decode offloading 和 encoder cache transfer，同时修复 transfer 失败、lease、cache consistency 等生命周期问题。

#17739 · #18907 · #18647 · #14455 · #16124 · #19251 · #19070 · #19480

投机与 bounded replay

引入 V4.1 SWA/decoder bounded replay 演进链、fixed-K PCP sharding、block verification 和 standalone draft model；收益需要接受率、图模式和 workload 共同验证。

#17742 · #17496 · #18936 · #18112 · #19138 · #19364

多模态与工程支撑

Qwen3.5-VL 图像预处理下沉 NPU，MRV2 encoder graph、CPU encoder cache offload；新增 runtime guard、profiling CI 与 release note fragment 工作流。

#16996 · #15571 · #13894 · #16849 · #18644 · #18875 · #18819

04 · 有数字的性能证据，应如何解读

以下均为作者报告的历史测试。本报告核对了对应 PR 的 merge SHA 与新增提交 SHA，但未复测结果；不同测试的基线、模型、runner、并发和软件栈不一致，表中数字不能相加或相乘。

PR / 优化证据层级作者数据限制与负面结果
#18506
PCP O projection 改为交换 activation		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测作者三轮中位数：V4 Flash decode +50.98%～53.09%；V4.1 +62.37%～63.52%。仅 decode 时间窗，非请求端到端吞吐；关闭 MTP/Prefix Cache/FlashComm 等，V4.1 还关闭 Engram。
#17263
合并多层 DSpark context WKV projection		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测作者四组成对测试几何均值：输出吞吐 +3.97%，mean TTFT −6.29%，mean TPOT −3.52%。测试针对特定长上下文配置；没有本报告的分支级复测。
#18074
SP GEMM 与 ReduceScatter 编译融合		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测作者 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、TP8、输入65536/输出64/C64：端到端吞吐约 +9%。另一个精度场景 GPQA-D 77.78→76.77，−1.01 pp；CANN 9.1 GLOBAL capture 存在限制。
#18717
A5 DFlash2 使用 CANN FlashAttn 和设备长度		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测作者单轮 GSM8K A/B：吞吐 +10.74%，mean TPOT −9.68%，TTFT −9.25%。输出 token 数少 1.70%，精度 −0.1516 pp；并非等工作量严格加速，FlashAttn 与同步改动为联合效果。
#16996
Qwen3.5-VL 图像预处理移到 NPU		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测PR 的 10K 输入/300 输出带图测试：104→116 tok/s，TTFT 2221→1914 ms。约 +11.5% 吞吐、−13.8% TTFT 是该场景作者数据；硬件/并发披露不完整，不外推到全部 VL。
#18390
恢复 310P MTP FULL graph decode		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测作者 TPOT 约 63.6→22.7 ms，15.6→43.1 tok/s；属于性能回归恢复。小样本且平台专属，不能推广到 910/A5 或普通非 MTP workload。
#15571
MRV2 encoder ACL Graph		作者报告：模型 / 服务实测PR 示例 TTFT 253.66→241.51 ms，−4.79%。具体 bucket/图配置和图片大小决定命中；不能视为默认所有图像请求收益。
#16542
24 次启动的 SWA index 构建融合为一次		作者报告：局部算子实测作者 11 shapes：98–410 μs→2.4–8.1 μs，几何平均约 47×；slot 输出逐位一致。这是 index 构建单阶段，不是服务吞吐 47×；不支持形状回退 eager。
#17068
BF16 router GEMM 保留 FP32 累加		作者报告：局部算子实测PR 报告 router 单算子 84.8→13.7 μs，约 6.2×；不是整模型 6.2×。收益依赖 gate 路由是否命中；逐模型验证专家选择及精度。
#18293
重做 hc_pre 分块与执行路径		作者报告：局部算子实测A3：432-token prefill 112.758→68.919 μs（−38.9%），decode 37.090→34.130 μs（−8.0%）。1-token prefill 29.469→31.170 μs（+5.8%，退化）；不能只报告大 shape 的收益。
#18907
减少 AscendStore lookup/save 的 Python 工作		作者报告：兼容移植实测兼容移植到已装 v0.30 runtime：input throughput +16.23%，Prefill metric +17.15%。各配置只一次正式 replay，非本 main head A/B；warm/cold 输出一致性问题在两侧都未解决。
#16730
GLM pooled indexing 接入 CANN		作者报告：联合 / 混合改动与 #18295 联合历史测试：4K/C8 吞吐 +30.46%，64K/C8 +21.25%。候选还包含其他上游变化，各 arm 一轮，不能拆成任一 PR 的独立收益；当前 head 的 PD/DSA-CP 回归仍待验证。
#16731
QLI 改用 CANN 原生算子		作者报告：局部算子实测历史 910B4-1 eager kernel 样本：19个合格 case 的 old/native median 24.98/22.87 μs。历史数据，缩减版本未重跑；不能据此声称 graph 或端到端同幅加速。
特别剔除误归因：#18596 的历史 −17.2% ITL 不是最终 mask-only 补丁的独立测量；#16730 与 #18295 共用联合结果；#18647 的三配置 TTFT 表不是补丁 A/B，KVPP+layerwise 组合仍有暴露开销。单算子 47× / 6.2× 也不是服务加速倍数。

#17068 BF16 router GEMM 保留 FP32 累加

[Performance][MoE] Use bf16 router GEMM with fp32 accumulation for bf16-origin weights (#17068)

优化机制 / 变化
以 BF16×BF16、FP32 输出的 torch.mm 替代符合条件的 FP32 router GEMM，并移除 runner 的无条件 FP32 预转换。
适用条件
BF16 权重和输入、无 bias；显式 FP32、DeepSeek V4 precast 与 310P 特殊路径继续走各自逻辑。
证据与结果
PR 报告 router 单算子 84.8→13.7 μs，约 6.2×；不是整模型 6.2×。
解释边界
收益依赖 gate 路由是否命中；逐模型验证专家选择及精度。

-    """Ascend GateLinear: FP32 router weight/compute on NPU.
+    """Ascend GateLinear: NPU counterpart of upstream's GEMM dispatch.

-    Skips GateLinear.__init__ (CUDA/ROCm GEMM probes). Signature matches
-    upstream for drop-in replacement; unused CUDA knobs are ignored.
+    Upstream tiers 1-3 are CUDA/ROCm cuteDSL kernels (unavailable on NPU);
+    this override keeps tier 4 and the tier 5 fallback:
+
+    - Tier 4: bf16 x bf16 with fp32 accumulation via torch.mm's out_dtype
+      epilogue (aclnnMm MatMulV3 on NPU, cf. the cuBLAS/hipBLASLt epilogue
+      upstream dispatches to). Each bf16 x bf16 product has at most 16
+      significant bits and is exact in the fp32 accumulator, so for
+      bf16-origin operands this is numerically equivalent to the fp32
+      upcast path, and ~6x faster at decode-time router shapes (e.g.
+      K=7168 / N=896 on Kimi K3).
+    - Tier 5: the ReplicatedLinear fallback with upstream's dtype
+      semantics: cast x to the weight dtype, compute, cast the output to
+      out_dtype.
+
+    ``out_dtype`` defaults to fp32 on NPU when the model passes None
+    (upstream leaves None and computes natively): the fp32-logits
+    contract keeps downstream NPU topk kernels on their validated path
+    and lets bf16-weight models (upstream DeepSeek-V2 / GLM5Next wiring)
+    take tier 4 directly.
+
+    A forced fp32 router stays fp32: models opt in explicitly via
+    params_dtype=torch.float32 / force_fp32_compute (e.g. MiniMax-M3), or
+    via the Ascend-specific precast_fp32_weight path (DSV4), which the MoE
+    runner routes around this forward entirely.
     """

diff --git a/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/turboquant_finalize.py b/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/turboquant_finalize.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Correct the TurboQuant scale and write compact cache rows in one launch."""
+
+import torch
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.triton_utils import get_vectorcore_num
+from vllm_ascend.quantization.methods.kv_cache.turboquant import HEAD_DIM, SLOT_BYTES
+
+# TurboQuant uses one byte per pair of 4-bit codes and stores one FP16 scale
+# after the code bytes. Reuse the cache layout constants for allocation and
+# pass the derived sizes as compile-time kernel arguments.
+CODE_BYTES = HEAD_DIM // 2
+
+
+# Prefill produces arbitrary row counts. Keep them out of the compilation key
+# so a new prompt length does not compile a kernel while decoding is active.
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["rows"])
+def _finalize(packed, norm, norm_lut, output, rows, CODE_BYTES: tl.constexpr, ROW_BYTES: tl.constexpr):
+    SCALE_LOW_OFFSET: tl.constexpr = CODE_BYTES
+    SCALE_HIGH_OFFSET: tl.constexpr = SCALE_LOW_OFFSET + 1
+    columns = tl.arange(0, CODE_BYTES)
+    for row in range(tl.program_id(0), rows, tl.num_programs(0)):
+        codes = tl.load(packed + row * CODE_BYTES + columns)
+        squared_norm = tl.load(norm_lut + codes.to(tl.int32))
+        selected_norm = tl.sqrt(tl.sum(squared_norm, 0))
+        original_norm = tl.load(norm + row).to(tl.float32)
+        scale = (original_norm / selected_norm).to(tl.float16).to(tl.uint16, bitcast=True)
+        tl.store(output + row * ROW_BYTES + columns, codes)
+        tl.store(output + row * ROW_BYTES + SCALE_LOW_OFFSET, (scale & 255).to(tl.uint8))
+        tl.store(output + row * ROW_BYTES + SCALE_HIGH_OFFSET, (scale >> 8).to(tl.uint8))
+
+
+def turboquant_finalize(packed: torch.Tensor, norm: torch.Tensor, norm_lut: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    rows = packed.shape[0]
+    output = torch.empty((rows, 1, SLOT_BYTES), dtype=torch.uint8, device=packed.device)
+    if rows:
+        _finalize[(min(rows, get_vectorcore_num()),)](packed, norm, norm_lut, output, rows, CODE_BYTES, SLOT_BYTES)
+    return output

diff --git a/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/msa/minimax_qknorm_rope_cache.py b/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/msa/minimax_qknorm_rope_cache.py
@@ -0,0 +1,229 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# Copyright (c) 2026 Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. All Rights Reserved.
+"""MiniMax-M3 packed QKV/index normalization, RoPE and paged cache insertion.
+
+Inputs can be a packed [Q, K, V, index Q, index K] projection or separate
+main/index projections. Each program processes one token, vectorizing Q/K
+and index Q/K together along contiguous head rows. K/V and index K go directly
+to independent cache slots; only the queries are materialized. Negative slots
+and graph-padding tokens never update a cache.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.triton_utils import extract_slice, insert_slice
+
+FP8_E4M3_MAX: tl.constexpr = 448.0
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_rope(
+    input_ptr,
+    weight_ptr,
+    cos_sin_ptr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    ROTARY_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    other_weight_ptr,
+    SPLIT_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    cols = tl.arange(0, HEAD_DIM)
+    heads = tl.arange(0, HEADS)
+    x = tl.load(input_ptr + heads[:, None] * HEAD_DIM + cols[None, :]).to(tl.float32)
+    weight = tl.load(weight_ptr + cols).to(tl.float32)
+    other_weight = tl.load(other_weight_ptr + cols).to(tl.float32)
+    weight = tl.where(heads[:, None] < SPLIT_HEADS, weight[None, :], other_weight[None, :])
+    x = x * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, 1) / HEAD_DIM + EPS)[:, None] * (1.0 + weight)
+    x = x.to(input_ptr.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    half: tl.constexpr = ROTARY_DIM // 2
+    cos = tl.load(cos_sin_ptr + tl.arange(0, half)).to(tl.float32)

+    def _initialize_pcp_o_proj_exchange_buffers(self) -> None:
+        """Allocate activation-typed collective storage before graph capture."""
+        pcp_size = get_pcp_group().world_size
+        compilation_config = self.vllm_config.compilation_config
+        decode_query_len = 1 + self.vllm_config.num_speculative_tokens
+        capacity = max(
+            self.vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * decode_query_len,
+            compilation_config.max_cudagraph_capture_size or 0,
+            max(compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or [0]),
+        )
+        input_size = self.n_local_heads * self.head_dim
+        output_size = self.wo_b.output_size_per_partition
+        dtype = self.vllm_config.model_config.dtype
+        device = self.wo_b.weight.device
+        # Compatible layers share storage because O projections execute in
+        # sequence. Forward slices the active bucket without reallocating or
+        # sending the unused capacity; all HCCL addresses stay graph-stable.
+        shapes = {
+            "_pcp_o_proj_ag_in_buf": (capacity, input_size),
+            "_pcp_o_proj_ag_out_buf": (pcp_size * capacity, input_size),
+            "_pcp_o_proj_rs_in_buf": (pcp_size * capacity, output_size),
+            "_pcp_o_proj_rs_out_buf": (capacity, output_size),
+        }
+        for name, shape in shapes.items():
+            key = ("dsa_pcp_o_proj_decode", name, device, dtype, shape)
+            buffer = self.o_proj_full_pools.get(key)
+            if buffer is None:
+                buffer = torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+                self.o_proj_full_pools[key] = buffer
+            setattr(self, name, buffer)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        layer_name,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        kv_cache: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None,

+    def __init__(
+        self,

+        layer_names: list[str],
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):

+        if self._spec_conv_indices is not None:
+            return
+        # Resolve the group's representative layer when building metadata.
+        # Only opted-in models allocate the additional convolution buffers.
+        layers = getattr(self.compilation_config, "static_forward_context", {})
+        if not getattr(layers.get(self._conv_layer_name), "use_contiguous_conv_indices", False):
+            return
+        # Each group owns its buffers, with fixed addresses for graph replay.
+        device = self.spec_sequence_masks.device
+        self._spec_conv_indices = torch.empty(self.spec_sequence_masks.numel(), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self._non_spec_conv_indices = torch.empty_like(self._spec_conv_indices)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _prepare_conv_indices(indices: torch.Tensor, buffer: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Mixed batches and ordinary graph decode already provide a contiguous
+        # vector. Matrix sources are prepared once, including single-row MTP.
+        if indices.ndim == 1 and indices.is_contiguous():
+            return indices
+        column = indices[:, 0] if indices.ndim == 2 else indices
+        requests = column.numel()
+        if requests > buffer.numel():
+            raise ValueError("Convolution index count exceeds the cache-group buffer capacity")
+        prepared = buffer[:requests]
+        prepared.copy_(column, non_blocking=True)
+        return prepared

+        """Whether both PROLOG_V3 projections use a supported quantization scheme.
+
+        PROLOG_V3's weight-quantization modes describe the complete projection
+        set. Mixed native/quantized projections and FP8 W8A8 must therefore
+        keep the legacy cache layout and preprocessing path.

+            AscendW8A8DynamicLinearMethod,
+            AscendW8A8MXFP8DynamicLinearMethod,
+        )

+        """Whether this MLA layer has the compressed-query ProLog contract."""

+            and self.q_proj is not None
+            and self.q_lora_rank is not None

+    def _promote_mtp_spec_decoding_attn_state(
+        self,
+        attn_state: Any,
+        *,
+        num_reqs: int,
+        num_scheduled_tokens: np.ndarray,
+        num_valid_tokens: np.ndarray,
+    ) -> Any:
+        """Map uniform MTP verify batches back to SpecDecoding on 310P.
+
+        Upstream #17461 intentionally uses ChunkedPrefill for MTP on 910-class
+        devices. 310P ACLGraph capture still tags SpecDecoding (splitfuse) via
+        ``ModelAclGraphManager310.make_dummy``; keep runtime/eager-gate aligned.
+        """
+        if self.speculative_config is None or num_reqs <= 0:
+            return attn_state
+        from vllm_ascend.attention.attention_v1 import AscendAttentionState
+
+        if attn_state not in (
+            AscendAttentionState.ChunkedPrefill,
+            AscendAttentionState.SpecDecoding,
+        ):
+            return attn_state
+        if not np.all(num_valid_tokens == 1):
+            return attn_state
+        if not np.all(num_scheduled_tokens == self.decode_query_len):
+            return attn_state

+    def reserve_oproj_buffers(self, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+        """Reserve graph-stable OTP storage before KV cache capacity is measured."""
+        if not oproj_tp_enable():
+            return
+        if not hasattr(self, "_oproj_buffer_pool"):
+            self._oproj_buffer_pool = OProjBufferPool()
+        oproj_tp_size = get_otp_group().world_size
+        if self.n_local_groups % oproj_tp_size != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"n_local_groups={self.n_local_groups} must be divisible by oproj_tensor_parallel_size={oproj_tp_size}"
+            )
+        # Decode is graph-bound when OTP is enabled. Profiling may use a larger
+        # scheduler budget, but it only needs to exercise this decode capacity.
+        exchange_num_tokens = get_potential_max_tokens()
+        group_hidden_dim = self.n_local_heads * self.head_dim // self.n_local_groups
+        buf_shape = (
+            oproj_tp_size,
+            exchange_num_tokens,
+            self.n_local_groups // oproj_tp_size,
+            group_hidden_dim,
+        )
+        self._oproj_send_buf, self._oproj_recv_buf = self._oproj_buffer_pool.get_exchange(buf_shape, dtype, device)
+        self._oproj_rs_out_buf = self._oproj_buffer_pool.get_reduce_scatter(
+            (exchange_num_tokens, self.wo_b.output_size), dtype, device
+        )

diff --git a/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/decoder_replay.py b/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/decoder_replay.py
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+REPLAY_BLOCK_SIZE = 1024
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["num_tokens_padded"])
+def _gather_replay_batch_kernel(
+    query_start_loc,
+    dropped_before,
+    seq_lens,
+    encoder_replay_start,
+    positions,
+    slot_mappings,
+    source_slot_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    rows_out,
+    query_start_loc_out,
+    positions_out,
+    slot_mappings_out,
+    slot_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    replay_start_out,
+    num_tokens_padded,
+    WINDOW: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_GROUPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0)
+    begin = tl.load(query_start_loc + req)
+    end = tl.load(query_start_loc + req + 1)
+    kept_begin = begin - tl.load(dropped_before + req)
+    kept_end = end - tl.load(dropped_before + req + 1)
+    kept_len = kept_end - kept_begin
+    if req == 0:
+        tl.store(query_start_loc_out, kept_begin)
+    tl.store(query_start_loc_out + req + 1, kept_end)
+    # Untrimmed requests also need the preceding window for their queries.
+    history = tl.where(kept_len < end - begin, 0, WINDOW - 1)
+    replay_start = tl.maximum(tl.load(seq_lens + req) - kept_len - history, 0)

diff --git a/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/compute_slot_mapping.py b/vllm_ascend/ops/triton/compute_slot_mapping.py
@@ -383,3 +383,91 @@ def compute_slot_mapping_fused_groups(
             PARALLEL_TILES=parallel_tiles,
             BLOCK_TABLE_WINDOW_SIZE=block_table_window_size,
         )
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["replay_window"])
+def _pad_replayed_slots_kernel(
+    query_start_loc_ptr,  # [num_reqs + 1], int32
+    positions_ptr,  # [num_tokens], int64
+    replay_start_ptr,  # [max_num_reqs], int32; 0 = this req does not replay
+    slot_mapping_addrs_ptr,  # [group_count], uint64: slot_mapping.gpu of each group
+    cacheable_groups_ptr,  # [NUM_GROUPS], int32: indices of the cacheable groups
+    replay_window,  # The one window every replaying group agrees on
+    PAD_ID: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_GROUPS: tl.constexpr,
+    TILE_BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Pad the replayed positions of the cacheable groups.
+
+    A request that hits a prefix cache keeps the hit's blocks, which are still
+    shared with every other request that hit the same prefix, so their KV must
+    not be written again -- the write would not be wrong, it would be a
+    *different* value landing in a block other requests read. The replayed
+    tokens are recomputed only to rebuild the sliding-window group, whose KV
+    does not survive in the prefix cache, so that group is the one that has to
+    keep its slots.
+
+    This runs after every group's slot mapping is final, so it covers the
+    context-parallel layouts too without knowing anything about them.
+    """
+    req_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    replay_start = tl.load(replay_start_ptr + req_idx)
+    # Guarding on the start rather than on the upper bound alone is what keeps
+    # a request that is not replaying -- whose replay_start is 0 -- from having
+    # its first window of tokens padded. A start below zero is malformed (the
+    # scheduler derives it from a hit count), and padding around it would write
+    # the window into positions that belong to this request, so it takes the
+    # same exit rather than shifting the interval left.
+    if replay_start <= 0:
+        return
+    write_end = replay_start + replay_window

+    def _fill_c8_mxfp_v_scale_caches(self) -> None:
+        """Initialize C8 V scales and retain views for page reassignment."""
+        self._c8_mxfp_v_scale_caches = []
+        num_blocks = self.kv_cache_config.num_blocks
+        if num_blocks <= 0:
+            return
+        for layer in self.compilation_config.static_forward_context.values():
+            if isinstance(getattr(layer, "impl", None), AscendC8MXFPAttentionBackendImpl):
+                value_scale_cache = layer.kv_cache[3]
+                assert value_scale_cache.shape[0] % num_blocks == 0
+                kernel_blocks_per_page = value_scale_cache.shape[0] // num_blocks
+                self._c8_mxfp_v_scale_caches.append((layer.v_cache_scale, value_scale_cache, kernel_blocks_per_page))
+                fill_mxfp_v_scale_cache(layer.v_cache_scale, value_scale_cache)
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        # Drop C8 packet views before the parent collects tensors and
+        # empties the allocator cache.
+        entries = getattr(self, "_c8_mxfp_v_scale_caches", None)
+        if entries is not None:

+"""External, unquantized FlashMLA implementation and metadata builder.
+
+Call FlashMLAImpl.load after selecting the worker device. Importing this module
+does not load cann_ops_transformer. FlashMLAImpl wraps the operator contract, while
+FlashMLAMetadataBuilder owns per-batch inputs, stable buffers and per-build refreshes.
+Callers own stream ordering and persistent KV writes. Tensor-content checks belong
+in preflight tests: the decode hot path must not copy lengths or tables to the CPU.
+"""

+

+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_runner import BatchReqState
+
+FLASHMLA_QK_DIM = 576
+FLASHMLA_V_DIM = 512
+FLASHMLA_BLOCK_SIZE = 128
+FLASHMLA_MASK_SIZE = 2048
+FLASHMLA_MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 65535
+
+
+def prepare_flashmla_batch_req_state(
+    batch_state: "BatchReqState", uniform_token_count: int | None
+) -> tuple["BatchReqState", int | None]:
+    """Order real decode before FIA prefill before inputs and graph dispatch.
+
+    Reorder the release request-state fields together so positions, KV slots
+    and sampling indices inherit the same order. A one-token prompt remains
+    FIA prefill and cannot reuse a graph captured for FlashMLA decode.
+    """

@@ -974,6 +975,91 @@ def _uses_single_raw_mla_cache(
     return supports_strided_mla_cache(vllm_config, attn_module, kv_cache_spec)


+def can_share_full_and_sliding_kv_cache(vllm_config: VllmConfig, specs: Iterable[KVCacheSpec]) -> bool:
+    """Keep Gemma 4's budget and the V2 runner on the same dense layout.
+
+    Equal physical pages let full and sliding-window groups overlay the same
+    pool even when their head dimensions and tokens per block differ. Keep
+    specialized/quantized caches and distributed transfer on their existing
+    allocation paths. Limit this regression fix to Gemma 4 so other models
+    retain their existing allocation behavior.
+    """
+    model_config = getattr(vllm_config, "model_config", None)
+    text_config = getattr(model_config, "hf_text_config", None)
+    if getattr(text_config, "model_type", None) != "gemma4_text":
+        return False
+    if vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype not in ("auto", "float16", "bfloat16"):
+        return False
+    specs = tuple(specs)
+    if {type(spec) for spec in specs} != {FullAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowSpec}:
+        return False
+    if vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None:
+        return False
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size != 1 or parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size != 1:
+        return False
+    layout = vllm_config.cache_config.get_resolved_kv_cache_layout()
+    if not (layout.is_layer_compact and layout.is_block_compact):
+        return False
+    return len({spec.page_size_bytes for spec in specs}) == 1 and all(
+        spec.dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+        and spec.kv_quant_mode == KVQuantMode.NONE
+        and spec.head_size == spec.head_size_v
+        and spec.page_size_bytes == spec.real_page_size_bytes
+        and spec.tokens_per_state == 1
+        and spec.num_head_slots is None
+        and spec.state_content_bytes is None
+        for spec in specs
+    )
+
+

建议做两组互补实验：① 固定权重、输入、采样和可兼容软件栈的单点 PR A/B；② 各版本受支持软件栈的升级整体 A/B。每组固定 runner、graph、量化、并行和缓存开关，完成相同 warmup，交替至少 3 组 paired runs，记录吞吐、TTFT/TPOT/ITL 分位、显存、接受率、精度和实际输出 token 数。当前报告不包含这些尚未执行的实验结果。
